facts: Some Search and Rescue (SaR) Dogs are trained to sniff out humans 1/4 mile away or more.
One unspayed female dog, her mate and their puppies can produce 67,000 puppies in six years.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect a drop of blood in a large swimming pool.
A dog's nose is wet because it helps to cool their body.
A dog's tail is an extension of their spine, and contains bones and muscles.
